what: While the section head rises from the bottom edge of the screen to 60% height, it unfolds from .94 scale · blur 8px · brightness .75 · opacity .35 to its natural state (tied to scroll, cubic out, top-center origin) — like peeling a skin, the next section rises from under the previous one.

options.end: Point where it is fully unfolded — height as a % from the top of the screen, default 60

from.where: shared.js AD.peel (original data-peel — heads of the News·Service·Company overview sections)
